name: Frontier Capital Ltd.
summary: Frontier Capital Ltd. functions as a non-banking financial company (NBFC), with its core business revolving around providing various loans and financial advances. The institution specializes in offering tailored financing solutions for heavy commercial vehicles and construction machinery. Its comprehensive service portfolio also includes hire purchase schemes, inventory funding, bill discounting, factoring, and associated insurance products. Established on June 13, 1984, the company's main office is located in Mumbai, India.
